items.title: RBI Steps Up Gold Loan Scrutiny as Bullion Rout Signals Strain
items.content: India’s banking regulator is stepping up scrutiny of the nation’s $247 billion gold-loan sector as a sharp drop in bullion prices erodes the collateral that lenders demand from borrowers, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Managing $300B for Ultra Wealthy Families: Masters in Business with Holly MacDonald
items.content: Barry speaks with Holly MacDonald, CEO of Bessemer Trust. They discuss her time working in Brazil and how investing in emerging markets shapes her investment philosophy. They also discuss the enduring strength of the US dollar, and how Bessemer evolved from a single family office to a $300 billion enterprise. They also discuss how they navigate building generational wealth and moderating family conflicts.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
items.content: Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year. Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, FIT Associate Professor Shawn Grain Carter, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, and Exemplary Luxury Group President and CCO Darcy Penick share their thoughts. (Source: Bloomberg)
